# Business model

A Business Model Canvas (Osterwalder and Pigneur, *Business Model Generation*, 2010) for an open core: an open compiler with closed products on top, a free tier for what costs nothing to run and a paid tier for what costs money to run. Each box lists the model elements tagged with that block; nothing is written here by hand.

Elements marked `proposed` or `open` are not operator decisions. Demand and willingness to pay are not measured: see the [gap report](gaps.md).

## Free and paid

The rule ([A feature is paid when it costs the project money to run](business-rules.md#rule-org-paid-when-costly), decided): A feature that runs on the user's machine or in their browser is free. A feature that needs the project's servers or bills is paid.

The operator decided the principle and two paid features: multiplayer collaboration and integrated hosted AI agents (log lines 43 and 91). Only an element that cites one of those lines carries a decided mark. Every mark marked proposed below is a proposal until the operator confirms it; tiers are designed after demand is validated (log line 79).
